text:
Situation: Phenylephrine hydrochloride has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-11-09 and remained listed for 71 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 64 units with 11 days on hand. Corvale General holds 126 units with 21 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows phenylephrine hydrochloride posted since 2020-11-09 and continuously listed through 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 11 to 21 days at present use rates. The top-ranked purchasing option is Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and is supplied from Caplin Steriles Limited, last inspected NAI on 2024-08-09. Four additional suppliers are also not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor inventory daily and report days on hand to pharmacy director; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. Pharmacy director to brief P&T committee on supply status at next meeting; requires P&T chair approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
